paragraphs: Chapter 957
Episode 235. Zito (6)
'Ah, damn it...'
Zito's vision was turning bright.
He felt the sharp light just touch his forehead. Jin's sword energy, blazing in gold, was sweeping over the lower part of the abyss in the sky and cutting Zito.
Crack, rip...!
Zito's head was splitting in half. His dark and vast physical form, like a human, was composed of flesh, bone, and organs.
A far-off past, the pain that had continued since the day the Sun God died, and the torture that had not rested for a day even towards himself.

There was no occasion to reveal his true form like now and fight, so it was not exposed, but for this reason, Zito's physical body was relatively less durable than other immortal beings of the same level.
The dried bones hidden beneath the skin as hard as rock were crumbling away without any resistance. Zito's skull was already split in half, and golden sword energy was bursting out of the gap.
His brain exploded and evaporated at the same time.
Even if he tried to stop it somehow by gripping the sword energy with his remaining arm, it was no use. His fingers were melting, and his arm was falling weakly.

Despite this, the ring that Jin had formed continued to pressure Zito. He initially intended to use it as a shield to block the explosion of the artificial sun, but every time the ring resisted the aftermath of the explosion, it contracted and shook Zito's innards.
Great noises continued, and space was constantly distorting.
However, only the space where Jin and Elona stood maintained its intact state. Not even a speck of smoke from the explosion was obstructing Jin.
'You, ah...!'
Thunk! The split head of Zito fell to the ground.

The physical body of an immortal did not lose its function even though it was so ruined. Through his eyes that had fallen apart left and right, he was looking at the altar of pain that was brutally being destroyed.
Poles that were broken and bent, and spread all over, and chunks of souls and life that had been hung on them came into his eyes.
Some became golden lumps wrapped in Jin's energy, while others were disappearing as they vanished.
Even Zito could not tell why their fates were divided due to some difference between them. He just felt an unspeakable discomfort.
'Are you... saying you have become a true king like the Sun God? Who the hell are you to determine their fate?'
Jin did not respond.
"Being focused on the Sun Splitting, I couldn't hear his voice clearly, and even if I could, it would have been the same. After all, Jin also did not know why they were differentiated.
'What are you that you can dismiss pain so efficiently? Heluram! You must be watching this place now. Give me an answer, why should I disappear here?'
Zito could not look into the abyss. His eyes were fixed on the ground, unable to move.

'You would know my feelings, Heluram. Didn't you say you respect the fate of the immortals born as byproducts of the sun, and my life, who suffered the most among them? Come out, Heluram! Come out and tell me a story I can accept...!'
Just then, Jin's sword touched Zito's heart.
'Keeheeheek!'
The fear of extinction was eroding him.
As proven in the previous battle with Ayula and when he reached out to the abyss to pull out the artificial sun, Zito had little tolerance for pain he could not control.
'It seems we are getting close to the end, Zito.'
Elona said, sweeping away the debris flying in front of Jin.
Because his heart was being split, Zito's power was also weakening. Now Elona was feeling less pain than before when she made contact with Zito.
'You seem to have relied heavily on Witch Heluram normally? I met her a thousand years ago too. She was not the type of person to trust and follow.'
The explosion of the artificial sun could no longer reach near Elona. The entire subspace was collapsing due to the aftermath of the explosion.
'All the orphans must pay a fair price! Even if you stop me, the witch will eventually do it. She will punish the orphans. Kahahahah...!'
A laugh like madness echoed.
Elona glanced at Zito's flesh that started to disintegrate by the obsession. She found Jin, who continued the Sun Splitting without paying any attention to Zito's madness, to be quite remarkable.
'Don't think you have won. As long as the witch exists, you can never live a safe life. Whatever new order appears in the world, it will eventually corrupt and betray you.'
As Zito finished his words, finally, the golden sword qi split his heart in two.
His panting heart that emitted dark purple started to slowly stop.

The tough tumors on the heart burst, and the rotten blood of pain splashed. Each drop that hit the ground shook the ground. The extremely condensed power of the Pain God was out of control and contaminating the subspace.
The blood and pus were more threatening than the artificial sun. At the moment when Elona tried to strengthen the shield against the poison smoke that rose as Zito's flesh oxidized, Jin spoke.
"Anyway, these guys always self-destruct when it's time to die."
"Jin, are you okay?"
"I'm fine. Now that I've cut the heart, I finally have time to speak. I'm a bit tired though."
Jin still maintained his bluntness.
It seemed that he could narrowly end it as initially anticipated. Having struck the head and heart, all that was left was to completely destroy Zito's entity so that it couldn't rise again.
The contraction of the golden rings accelerated.
The rings, maintaining the same light as at first, even closest to the pus and poison, constricted Zito.
And little by little, they converged into Jin's aura.
Each of these rings could be considered a type of magic made up of Jin's real energy. Thus, Jin had to completely retrieve the rings to fully recover later.
The last resort Zito could do was, of course, breaking the ring. The game was over, but Jin couldn't be allowed to go smoothly.
[Jin Runcandel, you're going with me.]
"If you wanted to realize that even a little, you should have taken a hostage in advance. Like you did to Phaelito."
Zito's pus and poison were persistently sticking to the ring. But the power of Zito, who lost his head and heart, couldn't overshadow the regenerative power Jin had.

"When I twisted the ring and pulled out the artificial sun, I was honestly a little dizzy. Then you shouldn't have pulled out the artificial sun, you should have tried to cut at least one ring. Then I couldn't be standing like this now."
Tswaaak...!
Eventually, the bluntness that had been slicing Zito's flesh like a bell all along stopped.
Although it fell so slowly, the trajectory passed by the sword was still not disappearing, spreading the radiance in place.
As if going down a road, the shrunken rings followed that trajectory and gathered into the sword. Every time a ring was absorbed, Jin's body, as hot as lava, cooled down.
About ten seconds passed.
No more voice was heard from Zito. Only the poison rising from the remaining tumors and the remnants of his dark flesh stained the empty space.
For about ten seconds, Jin and Elna sensed, on their tiptoes, Zito's energy. They felt nothing.
Zito had vanished. As the God of Pain and the one who ruled the true underworld for the longest time, he disappeared without leaving any kind of will.
"Whew, it's a pitiful end."
Jin said, slumping to the floor as if collapsing.
The price for using the Sun Split recklessly was being delivered belatedly. He felt like he couldn't take a step if he didn't recover his stamina, even a bit.
"You've worked hard. Finally, you've beaten him, Sir Jin......"
The victory was certainly easier than when dealing with other transcendent beings like Gliek, Hyeongsin, or Phaelito.
However, if Elona hadn't arrived, Jin would not have survived. Likewise, if Elona had faced Zito without Jin, she wouldn't have been able to display her full strength and would have perished.
"We must have won it together. It felt hopeless fighting without Murakan as planned, but then you showed up like a savior. Whoa."
Suddenly, Elona lifted Jin over her shoulder.
"You're not trying to kidnap me in my weakened state, are you?"
"Why would I do that? You seem a little numbed from exhaustion. Zito's poison is flowing on the ground."
"It was a joke. That filthy creature is exhausting me to the very end."
Bubbles... Sizzle!

The floor and walls of the void space were boiling like a rotten swamp. The air was hot with toxicity. It couldn't scratch Elona's protective shield or her strong body, but it was lethal to Jin in his current state.
"In my feeling, Zito's death is affecting the entire demon world. Probably most of the land of the demon world is boiling like this now."
"And I have this feeling that these remnants of Zito are gathering somewhere."

"Already recovered your senses that much? You read it right. The remaining energy of Zito spread all over the demon world, and the remnants of the artificial sun, they're all heading in one direction."
Jin and Elona instinctively thought of the same name.
"...Kelliark Zipfel. It must be him. Unless he's a witch."
The mere thought of his face gave him a creepy feeling. Maybe even the recently deceased Zito was just a puppet in his hands.
"From my memory, the witch isn't interested in such powers. Kelliark Zipfel... It must be him."
Jin lightly patted Elona's back.
"Don't worry about Veradin. Until Murakan dies, that guy will never die. And right now, I can't feel the death of the guardian dragon at all."
"I probably know the strength of prime Murakan better than you. He too is a terrifyingly strong being."
"If Zito's words are true and Murakan is really fighting Kelliark, the battle is still ongoing."
"Thanks to you handling most of Zito, I still have enough strength to fight."

"Even if I don't have the strength to wield a sword, we have to save Veradin. I'll rely on you and recover as much as possible by the time we reach where Zito's energy is gathering. Let's go quickly."
